# Barlow Condensed Bold, pinned copy

The game's one font (menus, HUD, big numerals), baked into `assets/ui/mf-font.sdf` by `tools/ui/bake_font.cpp`.
A condensed bold sans: numerals and capitals read from the couch at 28 px and up, and long menu lines stay narrow.
